output.denial_reason_cited: Policy POL-BCBS-2026-MRI-LUMBAR Criterion CRIT-2 Not Met: Submitted documentation did not include verified 6-week Physical Therapy attendance logs or physician progress notes verifying conservative treatment failure.
output.appeal_letter_narrative:
Dear Medical Director, We are submitting this formal appeal on behalf of our patient, Sarah Connor (PT-60481), to overturn the recent denial of a Lumbar Spine MRI without contrast (CPT 72148, ICD-10 M54.5). The initial adverse determination cited failure to meet Policy POL-BCBS-2026-MRI-LUMBAR Criterion CRIT-2 due to an absence of verified 6-week physical therapy attendance logs and physician progress notes confirming conservative treatment failure. We are writing to formally rebut this rationale with newly attached clinical documentation establishing clear fulfillment of all conservative care prerequisites.

Contrary to the prior determination, the patient has completed a rigorous, supervised course of conservative management. Specifically, the attached Physical Therapy Completion Log documents 12 completed sessions of structured physical therapy between June 1 and July 20, spanning a total duration of 7 weeks. Despite this dedicated 7-week therapeutic regimen, the patient experienced zero symptomatic relief, exhibiting persistent lower back pain and progressive left leg numbness lasting 10 weeks total. Physician progress notes from the Spine Clinic corroborate the complete failure of these conservative measures to mitigate the underlying pathology.

Given the persistence of radicular symptoms and neurological compromise (left leg numbness) lasting beyond six weeks despite documented physical therapy failure, advanced diagnostic imaging is clinically indicated to rule out structural nerve root compression, disc herniation, or other spinal pathology. Delaying imaging exposes the patient to the risk of permanent neurological deficit. We request an immediate reversal of this denial and prompt authorization for the requested lumbar spine MRI.
key_rebuttal_points: Patient completed 12 supervised physical therapy sessions over a 7-week duration, satisfying the 6-week conservative treatment threshold under Criterion CRIT-2.
Attached physical therapy completion logs and physician progress notes verify total conservative treatment failure with no symptomatic relief.

Patient presents with persistent lower back pain and left leg numbness of 10 weeks duration, meeting clinical necessity criteria for advanced neuroimaging to assess potential radiculopathy or structural pathology.
attached_supplements: Verified Physical Therapy Completion Log (June 1 - July 20)
output.recommended_next_step: Submit Level 1 appeal via payer portal immediately with the attached 7-week PT completion logs and updated physician progress notes.
